note: At standard depth, grounding IS included, but it contains ONLY orientation_context + orientation_ok. There is no 'reading' key (not even empty/undefined-typed — the key itself is absent, because attachDomainReading() is never called for assess_health). There is no 'domain_completeness' or 'completeness_directive' key either (attachDomainCompleteness() is also never called for assess_health) — confirms F-14's claim exactly. composition_report.counts.reading_families:0 is honest-but-structural: DOMAIN_READING_FAMILIES has no 'health' key so if attachDomainReading were called it would immediately return 0/0 anyway.
